shortDescription: Retreives a specific field from a secret in Delineas Secret Server

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination to save to file/attachment on the remote host

options.name: is_file
options.description: If the field is a file/attachment

options.name: sdk_config_directory
options.description: Directory where the SDK .config files are located (mutually exclusive with username/password authentication)

options.name: secret_field
options.description: The name of the field you want to get from the target secret

options.name: secret_name
options.description: The name of the secret you want to retreive from Secret Server (must be verbatim/exact match)

options.name: secret_server_host
options.description: The hostname of your Secret Server instance

options.name: secret_server_password
options.description: The password of the user that will be used to contact the Secret Server API (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: secret_server_username
options.description: The username of the user that will be used to contact the Secret Server API (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: secret_server_username_domain
options.description: The domain pertaining to your username. This is prepend to your username (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: use_sdk
options.description: If the module should use the SDK to authenticate with Secret Server (mutually exclusive with username/password authentication)
